metadataTitle: Help buying auto parts | Castillo Auto Parts
metadataDescription: We help you find the part that fits your vehicle and choose how to get it in San Salvador or Santa Tecla.

hero.description: Not sure which one you need? Send us your vehicle details, a photo or the part number. We will check compatibility with you before you buy.

intake.title: Send us these details so we can help
intake.vehicle: Make, model and year of the vehicle.
intake.engine: Engine or trim, if you know them.
intake.photo: A photo of the part, or its part number.
intake.note: You do not need to know the exact name of the part to ask us.

delivery.local: Local delivery in San Salvador and Santa Tecla.

steps.title: How we help you find it
steps.description: Clear guidance from your first question to delivery.
steps.tellUsTitle: Tell us what vehicle you have
steps.tellUsDescription: Share the make, the model, the year and anything else you know.
steps.verifyDescription: We confirm fitment and availability before you buy.
steps.chooseDescription: Pick warehouse pickup or local delivery where available.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Fitment, pickup, delivery and VAT. If your case is not here, write to us and we will look at it with your vehicle details.
faq.compatibilityQuestion: How do I know a part fits my vehicle?
faq.compatibilityAnswer: Search by make, model and year in the catalog. On the part page check the compatible vehicles, and if you are unsure, message us on WhatsApp before buying.
faq.pickupQuestion: Can I pick up my order at the warehouse?
faq.pickupAnswer: Yes. Warehouse pickup is free. When you choose it at checkout you will see the address, the hours and how to collect your order.
faq.deliveryQuestion: Do you deliver to my address?
faq.deliveryAnswer: We deliver locally in San Salvador and Santa Tecla. The fee is calculated from the municipality you select at checkout.
faq.taxAnswer: Yes. Part prices already include the 13% VAT. At checkout you will see the subtotal, the delivery fee where it applies, and the estimated total.
faq.notFoundQuestion: What if I cannot find the part?
faq.notFoundAnswer: Message us on WhatsApp with the make, the model and the year of your vehicle. You can also send the engine, a photo, the name of the part or a part number.
faq.ctaText: Write to us with your vehicle details and we will help you find it.

policyNote: To learn the conditions that apply to your purchase, ask us before confirming the order. We do not publish promises about warranties, exchanges or returns that are not defined yet.

closing.title: Ready to find your part?
closing.description: Filter the catalog by make, model and year, or write to us and we will look for it with you.
